unit: 19 problem-family blocks primary; 100 question clusters sensitivity; same resampling indices across runs/models/conditions
family_block_estimand: Question-weighted ratio-of-sums with all questions retained in each selected family; uneven block sizes do not become equal-family weights
pass_at_1: Average of four observed success indicators per question
pass_at_4: Indicator of >=1 accepted proof among four samples for each question/model/condition; averages across selected cells
conditional_compression: Equal-question average log2 change over shared measurable questions; selected-outcome comparison; exact rational products for tie/win comparisons
confidence_scope: Problem-family and question-mix bootstrap on curated fixed dataset; not population-wide inference or independent-attempt confidence
multiplicity: Exploratory intervals, no confirmatory multiple-testing claims
